subject: Invoice handling runbook for multi-payor renewal & upsell
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@acmetech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing routing for upcoming renewal & upsell

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the renewal summary yesterday. As we discussed, AcmeTech will sign the amendment for the additional capacity (upsell) but we need to clarify invoice routing for two payor entities in the EU (AcmeTech Ltd and AcmeTech GmbH). I attached a spreadsheet with the entity-level mapping and suggested PO placeholders.

Questions from procurement:
- Can Redwood issue separate monthly invoices per legal entity (so VAT is applied correctly), or do you prefer a consolidated invoice with VAT breakdown?
- We will provide two PO numbers; is there a preferred field for attaching POs to your billing system?
- For one entity (AcmeTech GmbH) our treasury asks for net60. The other will stay net30. Any issues with mixed terms on the same account?

Attachments: Acme_MultiPayor_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet listing entities, VAT ids, billing contacts)

Would appreciate a short runbook or set of steps we can follow to onboard the two payors into the renewal flow. If it's easier, loop in someone from your billing ops.

Best,
Marta
Procurement Manager, AcmeTech

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@acmetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing for upcoming renewal & upsell

Hi Marta — thanks for the spreadsheet and context. Looping in Ben (billing ops), Marissa (sales lead on the renewal) and Soojin (tax/compliance) so we can put together a short runbook.

High-level response:
- We can support separate invoices per legal entity. Best practice is to create two billing profiles in our system and attach the respective PO to each profile.
- PO attachment: POs should be sent as PDFs and we will attach them to the invoice record (we can accept PO number in the invoice metadata field and the PDF as the supporting doc).
- Mixed terms: We can honor different net terms per billing profile. That will manifest as separate invoice due dates, but the subscription code will be the same. If you want net60 on only the GmbH portion, we will map that in billing.

Next steps I propose (draft runbook):
1) Procurement sends final PO PDFs for each entity (PO number + PDF).
2) Provide legal entity names, VAT/Tax IDs, billing contact email for each.
3) Redwood creates two billing profiles and assigns PO to each.
4) For the upsell: record the amendment and map capacity cost to billing profiles proportionally (we will split by agreed allocation in the matrix).
5) Confirm payment terms per profile (net30/net60) and schedule first invoice date.

Ben — can you draft a quick billing-runbook doc and confirm any tax evidence Soojin will need for the GmbH?

Marta — will the matrix attached show the allocation percentage for the upsell or do you want Redwood to propose a split?

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

On 2028-06-18 09:12, Marta Lopez wrote:
> Hi Olga,
> 
> Thanks for the renewal summary yesterday...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing for upcoming renewal & upsell

Thanks Olga — I'll put together the runbook. Quick notes from billing ops:

- Separate billing profiles per legal entity is safest for VAT reclaim and reconciliations.
- PO workflow: please collect the PO PDF and the PO number. We ingest PO number into the invoice metadata and store the PDF as supporting documentation.
- For net terms: our system supports different payment terms per profile, but credit hold logic is account-wide; if one entity is late it may affect provisioning unless we scope enforcement by profile (we can operate a soft enforcement for this contract — see below).
- Tax evidence: Soojin, for the GmbH we'll need the VAT registration cert (or a screenshot from the EU VIES lookup) if AcmeTech intends zero-rate cross-border supplies. If AcmeTech is domestic, we just need the VAT id for the invoice header.

I'll attach a first pass: billing-runbook-v1.docx (checklist + example IMAP for attaching PO PDFs). Also recommending a single monthly cadence per entity rather than per-subscription; lower overhead.

Action items:
- Marta: send finalized PO PDFs and confirmation of allocation split (or let us propose a split).
- Soojin: list required tax docs for EU handling (we can include in the runbook).
- Marissa: confirm whether we should push DocuSign amendment now or wait until POs are in place.

Ben
Sr. Manager, Billing Ops — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Billing routing for upcoming renewal & upsell

All — good progress, thank you. Finalizing plan below so we have a single source of truth. Please treat this as the runbook for finance and sales ops execution.

Runbook (final):
1) Intake (today): Acme sends PO_7712.pdf and PO_7713.pdf (received). Confirmed allocation 60/40 (GmbH/Ltd). VAT cert for GmbH to be attached (procurement).
2) Billing profile creation (by 2028-06-23): Ben to create two billing profiles in the billing system with the following metadata: legal entity, VAT id, billing contact, PO number field populated, term (net30/net60).
3) Invoice cadence (monthly per entity): Generate consolidated monthly invoices per entity; include VAT header and a line-level allocation note for the upsell split.
4) Payment terms: GmbH on net60; Ltd on net30. Ben to set soft credit enforcement on this renewal to avoid an immediate service interruption for one late payor while preserving collections rules.
5) DocuSign (by 2028-06-24): Marissa to issue amendment via DocuSign (envelope linked below). Do not collect signatures until the PO PDFs are attached to the invoice records.
6) Audit evidence (by 2028-06-25): Soojin to confirm the exact VAT cert file type accepted and store in the contract evidence folder.
7) Confirm first invoice date and sample invoice for Acme: Ben to send a sample PDF to Marta for approval before the first billing run.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/AC-1347), DocuSign envelope (https://app.redwood.com/docsign/envelope/0a1b2c3d)

Ben/Marissa/Soojin — please confirm you have the items above on your 48-hour radar. Marta — once you confirm the VAT cert and we receive the POs, we'll queue the amendment for signature.

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: billing-runbook-v1.docx
